title: unify-sdks-auth-retries-streaming-parity-v1.187.0
author: Asha Patel
description: Summary: Unify SDK behaviors across Python/TypeScript/Go for auth, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics. This PR consolidates previous per-language divergences, fixes edge-case streaming reconnects, harmonizes retry/backoff defaults, and bumps SDK package versions to v1.187.0 to prepare for a coordinated release. Motivation: customers observed inconsistent retry behavior (different max attempts and backoff jitter) and streaming client APIs that required bespoke wiring per language. This caused operational surprises during autoscaling and made cross-language examples brittle. Changes: - Standardize auth token refresh hooks and expose an opt-in async refresh callback across all SDKs. - Normalize retry policy to use exponential backoff with jitter, default max_attempts=4, and reattempt on idempotent/non-idempotent rule parity. - Streaming client ergonomics: add automatic reconnect with resume token support, unified event callbacks, and stable TypeScript typings. - Parity & versioning: align public surface and examples, update CHANGELOGs, and bump package versions to v1.187.0. Backwards compatibility: defaults changed to safer retry limits (4 attempts) but behavior is opt-outtable via explicit policy. Checklist: - [x] Python: unified auth + retry wrapper implemented and unit tested. - [x] TypeScript: streaming resume + typings updated and integration tests added. - [x] Go: auth refresh + retry policy and examples updated. - [x] Docs and examples updated in redwood-examples. - [x] Changelog and package version bumps applied. Related: ENG-2345 (SDK parity), ENG-2401 (streaming reconnect), SUP-1023 (customer report).

review_comments: Matt Johnson: Left small nits on the TypeScript typings - prefer upstreaming the event union for better autocomplete. Also, make sure the reconnect backoff doesn't thrash the server under mass reconnects.
Asha Patel: Reply: addressed typings via explicit EventUnion export and added server-friendly reconnect backoff with capped jitter. See commit d4e5f6g.
Priya Singh: Question: Is the default max_attempts=4 documented clearly in migration notes? Some customers explicitly relied on higher default retries.
Asha Patel: Reply: added migration note and example for opting into previous behaviour via RetryPolicy(max_attempts=8) in Python/Go and RetryPolicy({maxAttempts:8}) in TS.
Diego Alvarez: Approved after verifying Python unit tests and streaming integration logs. Verified resume token roundtrips on long-lived streams.
